title: looking for fun games to try out!
author: NoushieHere
selftext: hey I've been on the look out for fun games to try out recently. i especially love horror, so in the spirit of halloween please send them my way! on the contrary, if there's anything cute, or with animals I'd love to see that as well. even if your game doesn't fit these two categories, send it my way and I'd love to check it out

comments.author: AlkrssveGames
comments.body:
We made and are working on Spell Unbound. It's a Pokémon Ranger inspired roguelite, and we'd love to any thoughts/feedback!

You can check it out on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5037500/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=organic_post) or [Itch.io](https://alkrssve.itch.io/spell-unbound)!

comments.author: Upbeat_Ingenuity_745
comments.body: For the cute/animals side, you might dig monster collecting games with cozy vibes. I'm building Poplet: A Fidget Popper Rpg, which is a casual fidget game where you raise cute monsters through bubble popping, gardening, and fishing.

replies.author: NoushieHere
replies.body: hey this seems like a really cute idea. is there anywhere I can play it?

replies.author: Upbeat_Ingenuity_745
replies.body:
Yea tried to make a small but unique game for once. Currently working on gardening 2.0.

Here's the download: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.poplet.mobile

comments.author: NoushieHere
comments.body: this is so much fun, i actually love multiplayer shooter games. reminds me so much of cod mobile! i also like the claude, gpt and grok characters haha

replies.author: Virtual_Hair_1987
replies.body: Appreciate it!!! now time square map already on the game

comments.author: NoushieHere
comments.body: this is a lot of fun! takes a while to load but love the story vibes and the fact that there is another character with the lead.

replies.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
replies.body: Thanks for trying it out. And i always liked the zombie games with coop so that's where the idea came from.

comments.author: NoushieHere
comments.body: Love the pumpkin costume, this is a lot of fun- I don't think I've come across the idea of browser boxing before lol!

replies.author: boxing-boxing
replies.body: I'm glad you think so,  i've been spending way too much time making this 😄

comments.author: landocs
comments.body: you might enjoy [Human or Not’s group chat](https://humanornot.so/group-chat?utm_source=chatgpt.com), it’s a fun little guessing game where you chat and try to figure out who’s AI. could be something different to try between horror games!
